description: This file contains utility functions and orchestration logic for handling code coverage profiling in a PyTorch-based testing environment, including running tests, merging profile data, and exporting coverage reports.

methods.name: None create_corresponding_folder( cur_path: str, prefix_cur_path: str, dir_list: list[str], new_base_folder: str )
methods.description: Creates folder structure in a new base directory to mirror the structure of a source directory, for a list of directories.

methods.name: None run_target( binary_file: str, raw_file: str, test_type: TestType, platform_type: TestPlatform )
methods.description: Runs a specified binary with a raw profile filename, setting environment variables and choosing the test execution method based on test type and platform.

methods.name: None merge_target(raw_file: str, merged_file: str, platform_type: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Merges raw profile data into a merged profile using llvm-profdata, based on the platform type.

methods.name: None export_target( merged_file: str, json_file: str, binary_file: str, shared_library_list: list[str], platform_type: TestPlatform, )
methods.description: Exports coverage data to a JSON report using llvm-cov, for a given merged profile, binary, and shared libraries.

methods.name: None merge(test_list: TestList, platform_type: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Traverses raw profile directories, creates corresponding merged profile directories, and merges raw profiles into merged profiles if they match the test list.

methods.name: None export(test_list: TestList, platform_type: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Traverses merged profile directories, creates JSON report directories, and exports coverage reports for merged profiles, adjusting for platform-specific binary and shared library paths.
